posts.text:
A mother and daughter were nearly killed when their car was struck and flipped four times. ICE arrested them at the hospital. No criminal history or removal orders for either. 

www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026...
posts.summary: Criticizes ICE arrest of accident victims with no criminal history
